rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Names are the determinate forms by which divine attributes and essence are known: their identities signify attributes and essence, existence signifies His face, and their individuation His unity.
rows.anchor: اسم الشيء ما يعرف به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Allah names the divine essence absolutely, without reference either to its being qualified by attributes or to its lack of attributes.
rows.anchor: اسم للذات الإلهية من حيث هي هي على الإطلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The All-Merciful grants existence and perfection universally according to wisdom and each recipient’s capacity at the beginning.
rows.anchor: هو المفيض للوجود والكمال على الكل بحسب ما تقتضي الحكمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Especially Merciful grants the human kind its particular spiritual perfection at the end; the perfected human form gathers universal and special mercy and manifests the divine essence and all attributes.
rows.anchor: هو المفيض للكمال المعنوي المخصوص بالنوع الإنساني بحسب النهاية

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says he was given comprehensive speech and sent to complete noble character; existent things are realities, while noble character’s states and sources of action are gathered in the universal human being.
rows.anchor: أوتيت جوامع الكلم، وبعثت لأتمم مكارم الأخلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prophets placed alphabet letters opposite levels of beings; existence emerged from bāʾ because it follows the alif symbolizing God’s essence, and bāʾ signifies the first intellect, God’s first creation.
rows.anchor: ظهرت الموجودات من باء بسم الله إذ هي الحرف الذي يلي الألف الموضوعة بإزاء ذات الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first intellect is addressed in a report that God created no creature dearer or more honored, and acts of giving, taking, reward, and punishment occur through it.
rows.anchor: ما خلقت خلقا أحب إلي ولا أكرم علي منك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmala has eighteen pronounced letters and nineteen written letters; when words are separated, the count becomes twenty-two.
rows.anchor: والحروف الملفوظة لهذه الكلمة ثمانية عشر، والمكتوبة تسعة عشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eighteen signifies eighteen thousand worlds, whose principal realms are the dominion, kingdom, Throne, Footstool, heavens, elements, and three genera of offspring.
rows.anchor: فالثمانية عشر إشارة إلى العوالم المعبر عنها بثمانية عشر ألف عالم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The nineteenth letter signifies the human world as a distinct realm because humanity’s nobility and comprehensiveness gather the whole cosmos, as Gabriel is distinguished among angels.
rows.anchor: والتسعة عشر إشارة إليها مع العالم الإنساني، فإنه وإن كان داخلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Three hidden alifs complete the twenty-two letters and signify the divine world in respect of essence, attributes, and acts: three in detailed consideration, one in realization.
rows.anchor: والألفات الثلاثة المحتجبة التي هي تتمة الاثنين والعشرين عند الانفصال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The three written alifs signify those worlds appearing in the supreme human manifestation while the divine world remains veiled.
rows.anchor: والثلاثة المكتوبة إشارة إلى ظهور تلك العوالم على المظهر الأعظمي الإنساني ولاحتجاب العالم الإلهي

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: Asked where the alif of the basmala went, the Messenger replies that Satan stole it; he orders the bāʾ lengthened in its place.
rows.anchor: سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن ألف الباء من أين ذهبت؟ قال صلى الله عليه وسلم: " سرقها الشيطان "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lengthening bāʾ compensates for the hidden alif: divinity is concealed in diffusive mercy and appears in human form, knowable only to its people, hence the indefinite form.
rows.anchor: وأمر بتطويل باء بسم الله تعويضا عن ألفها إشارة إلى احتجاب ألوهية الإلهية في صورة الرحمة الانتشارية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A hadith says God created Adam in His image; the author explains a hierarchy of veils from essence by attributes, from attributes by acts, and from acts by beings and effects.
rows.anchor: إن الله تعالى خلق آدم على صورته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disclosure of acts beyond the veil of created effects yields trust; disclosure of attributes beyond acts yields contentment and surrender; disclosure of essence beyond attributes yields annihilation in unity and absolute unification.
rows.anchor: فمن تجلت عليه الأفعال بارتفاع حجب الأكوان توكل، ومن تجلت عليه الصفات بارتفاع حجب الأفعال رضي وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unification of acts precedes unification of attributes, which precedes unification of essence; the three are reflected in the Prophet’s prostration supplication seeking refuge in pardon, pleasure, and God Himself.
rows.anchor: فتوحيد الأفعال مقدم على توحيد الصفات وهو على توحيد الذات وإلى الثلاثة أشار صلوات الله عليه في سجوده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praise in action and in the tongue of each thing’s state is the appearance of its perfections and attainment of its ends, a fitting opening tribute to its Lord.
rows.anchor: الحمد بالفعل ولسان الحال هو ظهور الكمالات وحصول الغايات من الأشياء إذ هي أثنية فاتحة ومدح رائعة لموليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All beings praise and glorify God through their particular properties, orientation toward ends, and actualization of potential; their dependence on Him alone denies partners and deficiency and manifests His majesty and beauty. The Qur’an says every thing glorifies Him.
rows.anchor: فالموجودات كلها بخصوصياتها وخواصها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is Lord of the worlds as origin, preserver, and manager of all; worlds means everything known to God, and the sound masculine plural reflects encompassing knowledge or predominance.
rows.anchor: وخص بذاته بحسب مبدئيته للكل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine provision includes general and particular good: outward blessings such as health and livelihood, and inward blessings such as knowledge and recognition.
rows.anchor: وبإزاء إفاضة الخير العام والخاص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is owner at the final return and recompense; only the worshipped one to whom sovereignty returns can reward enduring blessing for perishable life, as servants shed acts and attributes and receive true existence after annihilation.
rows.anchor: وباعتبار منتهائيته التي هي معنى مالكية الأشياء في يوم الدين إذ لا يجزي في الحقيقة إلا المعبود الذي ينتهي إليه الملك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All praise belongs to God eternally according to His due, at beginning, end, and everything between; He is both praiser and praised, worshipper and worshipped, in detail and in unity.
rows.anchor: فله تعالى مطلق الحمد وماهيته أزلا وأبدا على حسب استحقاقه إياه بذاته باعتبار البداية والنهاية وما بينهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeing God’s attributes in His speech leads servants to address Him by worship and ask His aid, since they see no other object of worship or independent power; every motion becomes worship and love seeks His beauty everywhere.
rows.anchor: ولما تجلى في كلامه لعباده بصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer asks to be kept firmly on the path of unity: the special mercy of essential knowledge, love, and guidance, traversed by prophets, martyrs, the truthful, and saints who witness God in every aspect and vanish from the transient shadow-self.
rows.anchor: ثبتنا على الهداية ومكنا بالاستقامة في طريق الوحدة التي هي طريق المنعم عليهم بالنعمة الخاصة الرحيمية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those under wrath are like Jews who stop at outward forms and bodily pleasures, veiling themselves from spiritual truths and intellectual delight; wrath entails expulsion, distance, and darkness of appearances.
rows.anchor: الذين وقفوا مع الظواهر، واحتجبوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The astray are like Christians who stop at inner lights and special mercy, overlooking God’s outward manifestation and losing vision of the beloved’s beauty throughout creation.
rows.anchor: الذين وقفوا مع البواطن التي هي الحجب النورانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammadan unifiers answer the calls to seek pardon and paradise, fear God and believe His messenger, and worship God without partners, thereby combining love of the essence’s beauty with the attributes’ goodness.
rows.anchor: ودعوة المحمديين الموحدين إلى الكل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unified path joins hope and fear, prayer for complete light, steadfastness, gardens, reward and light, seeing God’s face wherever one turns, and the best reward with increase.
rows.anchor: يقولون ربنآ أتمم لنا نورنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who do good receive the best and an increase, completing the cited evidence that the unified servants are rewarded with both mercy and divine vision.
rows.anchor: للذين أحسنوا الحسنى وزيادة [يونس، الآية: 26]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Highest, Greatest Name is the essence together with all attributes; glorification is the self’s stripping away everything but the Real so all divine perfections emerge, the special praise of annihilation, and each thing has a particular glorification through a particular divine name.
rows.anchor: اسمه الأعلى والأعظم هو الذات مع جميع الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation made the outward human form, then proportioned its constitution with a particular temperament capable of receiving the most complete spirit and all perfections.
rows.anchor: عدل بنيتك على وجه قبلت بمزاجه الخاص الروح الأتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God deposited complete human-kind perfection in the person and guided it to be brought forth and actualized through purification and refinement.
rows.anchor: إلى إبرازه وإظهاره وإخراجه إلى الفعل بالتزكية والتصفية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pasture is worldly adornment, benefits, food, and drink, grazing for the animal soul and pasture for the powers that serve it.
rows.anchor: أي: زينة الحياة الدنيا ومنافعها ومآكلها ومشاربها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worldly pasture quickly perishes like blackened brittle stubble; do not turn toward or occupy yourself with it, lest it block special glorification and conceal your destined perfection, which alone endures.
rows.anchor: سريع الفناء وشيك الزوال كالهشيم والحطام البالي المسود فلا تلتفت إليه ولا تشتغل به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The most wretched is one veiled from the Lord, lacking readiness and spiritually distant, worse than the prepared person whose readiness has lapsed and who is veiled by the dark qualities of the self.
rows.anchor: المحجوب عن الرب، العديم الاستعداد، النائي القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The great fire is the fire of veiling from the Lord by associating others and stopping at them, then fires of coercion, wrath, and the effects of hell through four stations from dominion to divinity, lasting forever; the second person experiences only the fire of effects.
rows.anchor: التي هي نار الحجاب عن الرب بالشرك والوقوف مع الغير، ونار القهر في مقام الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The damned cannot cease to exist and are spiritually ruined, enduring torment and wishing for death; each time they burn and perish they are restored, so they are neither absolutely dead nor alive.
rows.anchor: بالحقيقة لهلاكه الروحاني أي: يتعذب دائما سرمدا في حالة يتمنى عندها الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The successful person wins by cleansing the self’s qualities and the body’s darkness after attaining spiritual readiness.
rows.anchor: فاز وظفر من تطهر عن صفات نفسه وظلمات بدنه بعد حصول استعداده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering the nurturing name means invoking the particular name that grants the perfection one’s innate readiness seeks, such as Knower for the ignorant, Guide for the astray, or Forgiver for the sinner; it is truly the essence hidden by effects and self-qualities.
rows.anchor: الاسم الخاص الذي يربه به بإفاضة كماله الذي يسأل ربه بلسان استعداده كالعليم للجاهل والهادي للضال والغفار للمذنب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering is knowing God and seeking one’s particular perfection through divine aid; prayer is worship of the Real disclosed in the form of that name after one sees its destined perfection. The verse about forgetting God explains self-forgetting.
rows.anchor: وذكره تعرفه وطلب كماله المخصوص به بالتأييد الرباني والتوفيق الإلهي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People prefer sensory life and its ornaments, thereby neglecting remembrance of the divine name and prayer because they lack purification; the true spiritual life is better and more enduring.
rows.anchor: تغفلون وتحتجبون عن ذكر ذلك الاسم وصلاة الرب بالحياة الحسية وطيباتها وزخارفها لعدم التزكية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This teaching about receptive people benefiting from reminders, the unready suffering, the purified flourishing, and sensory-life seekers perishing is found in the ancient scriptures, preserved in luminous tablets disclosed to the two prophets mentioned.
rows.anchor: المعنى من انتفاع المستعد بالتذكير وعدم انتفاع العديم الاستعداد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The overwhelming event is either the great resurrection, which overwhelms and annihilates essences through self-disclosure, or the lesser death, whose throes overwhelm the intellect; in either case people divide into wretched and blessed.
rows.anchor: الداهية التي تغشى الناس بشدائدها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The faces are selves, humbled and fearful.
rows.anchor: أي: ذليلة خائفة { عاملة ناصبة }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They labor continually at severe tasks, such as descending the fire’s levels, climbing its obstacles, and carrying burdensome forms caused by their deeds; alternatively, the wardens force them into painful tasks resembling their worldly deeds, yielding only toil and punishment.
rows.anchor: تعمل دائبا أعمالا صعبة تتعب فيها كالهوي في دركات النار والارتقاء في عقباتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their hot fire is a fire of nature’s effects, painful in measure of their worldly actions.
rows.anchor: من نيران آثار الطبيعة { حامية } مؤذية مؤلمة بحسب ما تزاولها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The boiling spring is compounded ignorance and false, harmful belief, their drink.
rows.anchor: من الجهل المركب الذي هو مشربهم والاعتقاد الفاسد المؤذي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The thorny food signifies false, useless, harmful knowledge such as sophistry, disputation, and fallacies: it neither strengthens the soul nor quiets its appetite for learning and debate.
rows.anchor: الشبه والعلوم الغير المنتفع بها المؤذية كالمغالطات والخلافيات والسفسطة وما يجري مجراها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some wretched people may be resurrected in the image of their food, dry thorn; others may resemble zaqqum or ghislin.
rows.anchor: ويمكن أن يحشر بعض الأشقياء على صور طعامهم الشبرق اليابس كالزقوم لبعضهم والغسلين لبعضهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessed faces show the radiance and luminosity of their refined, disembodied state; they are grateful and content with striving in virtue and the way to God, without regret or withdrawal from what they did.
rows.anchor: تظهر عليها نضرة النعيم من اللطافة والنورية لتجردهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The high garden is a garden of divine attributes and the holy presence, lofty in rank.
rows.anchor: من جنان الصفات وحضرة القدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No idle speech is heard because its inhabitants speak wisdom, knowledge, glorification, and praise.
rows.anchor: لأن كلامهم الحكمة والمعرفة والتسبيح والتحميد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The running spring signifies streams of knowledge of gnosis, spiritual taste, unveiling, direct awareness, and unity.
rows.anchor: من عيون مياه علوم المعارف والذوق والكشف والوجدان والتوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Raised couches signify ranks of divine names attained by taking on divine attributes, raised above bodily ranks.
rows.anchor: من مراتب الأسماء الإلهية التي بلغوها بالاتصاف بصفاته رفعت قدرها عن مراتب الجسمانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Placed cups signify qualities and beauties of immaterial essences, vessels for the wine of love, remaining fixed in their places.
rows.anchor: من أوصاف الذوات المجردة ومحاسنها التي هي ظروف خمور المحبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ordered cushions signify stations in the ranks of attributes; each attribute unfolds from disclosure and illumination through a state to perfected adoption and possession, giving each seeker a seat according to readiness.
rows.anchor: من مقاماتهم ومقاعدهم في مراتب الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Spread carpets signify stations of theophanies of acts, which lie beneath the stations of attributes, as trust lies beneath contentment.
rows.anchor: من مقامات تجليات الأفعال التي تحت مقامات الصفات كالتوكل تحت الرضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People should consider visible effects and cross from them to the manifestation of communion and then attributes.
rows.anchor: إلى الآثار الظاهرة بالحس فيعتبرون ويعبرون عنها إلى تجلي الوصل إلى تجلي الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reminding may benefit someone prepared to ascend toward God; whoever turns away and is veiled by effects from their cause faces the great fire, defined as punishment for absolute veiling across all levels of existence.
rows.anchor: عسى أن يكون فيهم مستعد يتذكر ويتعظ فيرتقي في السلم المنخلعة إلى جناب الحق لا من أعرض واحتجب بهذه الآثار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause that the Messenger is only a reminder and not a controller is an interruption: his duty is to remind, not overpower or compel, as the cited verses also say.
rows.anchor: اعتراض أي: ما إليك إلا التذكير لا الغلبة والقهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People return to God alone, who keeps their account and punishes; coercion and control belong to Him, not the Messenger.
rows.anchor: أي: خاصة إلينا إيابهم لا إلى غيرنا، فإنا نحاسبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ten nights first signify the ten outward and inward senses specified when spirit first attaches to bodily matter, the instruments for acquiring perfection.
rows.anchor: ومحال الحواس العشرة الظاهرة والباطنة التي تتعين عند تعلقه به لكونها أسباب تحصيل الكمال وآلاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pair signifies spirit joined to body, completing a human being capable of attainment; the odd signifies the immaterial spirit when it separates.
rows.anchor: أي: الروح والبدن عند اجتماعهما وتمام وجود الإنسان الذي يمكن به الوصول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the oaths describe the great resurrection: dawn is divine light appearing in the soul’s night; ten are dormant senses during self-disclosure; the pair is witness and witnessed before complete annihilation; the odd is the oneness after duality ends; night is selfhood disappearing.
rows.anchor: الفجر الذي هو مبتدأ طلوع نور الحق وتأثيره في ليلة النفس وليال عشر من الحواس الراكدة الهادئة المظلمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A second alternative is the lesser resurrection of death: dawn is the sun rising from the west, the ten are dimmed senses, the pair spirit and body, the odd the separated spirit, and night the body’s darkness dispersing.
rows.anchor: أي: فجر ابتداء ظهور نور الشمس الطالعة من مغربها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One proposed oath-answer is that the veiled will be punished, as indicated by the account from ʿĀd through the statement that God watches.
rows.anchor: وجواب القسم ليعذبن المحجوبون لدلالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the passage confirms that only pure intellects discern the lesson; the oath’s answer is that discerning, reflective people will be rewarded rather than the veiled.
rows.anchor: وجواب القسم: ليثابن العقلاء المعتبرون بحال المحجوبين دونهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A saying divides faith into two halves, patience and gratitude; the author uses it to require either response to God’s tests.
rows.anchor: الإيمان نصفان، نصف صبر ونصف شكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When tested with ease and blessings, a person must thank God by using them to honor orphans, feed the poor, and do what pleases Him, not boast of deserving them, indulge, attach to wealth, or withhold from those entitled.
rows.anchor: فعليه أن يشكره باستعمال نعمته فيما ينبغي من إكرام اليتيم وإطعام المسكين وسائر مراضيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When tested with poverty, a person must be patient rather than despair or claim God dishonors him; deprivation may protect him from distraction and direct him toward God, while wealth may be gradual enticement.
rows.anchor: أو بالفقر وضيق الرزق فيجب عليه أن يصبر ولا يجزع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tranquil soul has received serenity and been illuminated by certainty, becoming at rest in God instead of agitation.
rows.anchor: التي نزلت عليها السكينة وتنورت بنور اليقين فاطمأنت إلى الله من الاضطراب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After completing the attributes, the soul returns to the essence in contentment rather than stopping at the attributes; contentment with God follows God’s contentment with the soul.
rows.anchor: إذا تم لك كمال الصفات فلا تسكني إليه وارجعي إلى الذات في حال الرضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Entering God’s servants means joining His special servants who have realized essential unity.
rows.anchor: في زمرة عبادي المخصوصين بي من أهل التوحيد الذاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Entering God’s garden means the garden particular to Him, the garden of the essence.
rows.anchor: المخصوصة بي أي: جنة الذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Two variant readings are reported: in My servant, and in the body of My servant; the latter refers to resurrection and the return of spirits to bodies.
rows.anchor: وقرىء في عبدي وقرىء في جسد عبدي أي: حالة البعث والنشور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Thick veiling by nature and sickness of heart makes the person think no one can overpower him; he boasts of having spent much on public favors as a way to lord it over people, mistaking wasteful display for virtue.
rows.anchor: لغلظ حجابه ومرض قلبه لاحتجابه بالطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Arabic boast about having expended much can mean spending on someone to claim superiority, with Arab usage cited for the expression.
rows.anchor: إذا أنفق عليه يتفضل على الناس بالتبذير والإسراف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He wrongly assumes God did not see his inner motive: spending for reputation, vanity, and boasting rather than God’s pleasure compounds vice instead of making virtue.
rows.anchor: أيحسب أن لم يطلع الله تعالى على باطنه ونيته حين ينفق ماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those characterized by the preceding virtues are the blessed people of the right and inhabitants of the holy world.
rows.anchor: الموصوفون بهذه الفضائل هم السعداء أصحاب اليمين وسكان عالم القدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who disbelieve in God’s signs are veiled from His true qualities, ill-fated inhabitants of the realm of impurity, confined forever by the fire of nature’s effects and cut off from spirit and spiritual ranks.
rows.anchor: حجبوا عن هذه الصفات التي هي آيات الله الحقيقية التي تعرف بها ذاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heaven is the animal spirit that forms this existence’s heaven; the earth is the body, which God spread out.
rows.anchor: أي: الروح الحيوانية التي هي سماء هذا الوجود والقادر الذي بناها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul may mean the animal potency impressed in animal spirit, the whole composite, or the rational soul; God balanced it between lordship and lowliness, neither bodily darkness nor spiritual light.
rows.anchor: القوة الحيوانية المنطبعة في الروح الحيوانية المسماة باصطلاح أهل الشرع والتصوف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Depending on which soul is meant, its balance is like neither east nor west, a proportioned temperament, or readiness for perfection between the two worlds.
rows.anchor: عدلها بين جهتي الربوبية والسفالة لا في ظلمة الجسم وكثافته ولا في ضوء الروح ولطافته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made the soul know wickedness and godfearing through angelic prompting and the material intellect’s capacity to recognize the good of piety and evil of sin.
rows.anchor: أفهمها إياهما وأشعرها بهما بالإلقاء الملكي والتمكين من معرفتهما وحسن التقوى وقبح الفجور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The successful reach perfection and the original fitra by purifying the soul.
rows.anchor: بالوصول إلى الكمال وبلوغ الفطرة الأولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The failed hide the soul in the body’s soil, away from divine light and mercy.
rows.anchor: وأخفّاها في تراب البدن عن نور الحق ورحمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oath’s omitted answer is that veiled deniers of the Prophet will perish through transgression as Thamud did, because they reject the inspiration, remain sinful, veil intellect, and let the dark self dominate.
rows.anchor: ليّهلكن المحجوبون المكذبون للنبي بطغيانهم كما أهلكت ثمود لتكذيبهم نبيهم بطغيانهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The giving is not repayment or exchange; it seeks the Lord’s face by turning from everything else and represents the highest piety.
rows.anchor: أي: لا يؤتيه للمكافأة والمعارضة { إلا ابتغاء وجه ربه }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each divine name has a face through which God discloses Himself to one who calls upon and worships Him with that name’s readiness; the highest face belongs to the all-encompassing Highest name, and the Lord is that name if the phrase is adjectival.
rows.anchor: لأن الله تعالى بحسب كل اسم له وجه يتجلى به لمن يدعوه بلسان حاله بذلك الاسم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satisfaction comes through reaching God in unified essential witnessing, then seeing that face in differentiated abiding after annihilation, since satisfaction requires existence with the attribute.
rows.anchor: بالوصول إليه في عين الجمع والشهود الذاتي ثم مشاهدة ذلك الوجه في مقام التفصيل حال البقاء بعد الفناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The later state is disclosure after concealment and intensified longing, better than the earlier state because it is secure from selfhood’s residual variegation.
rows.anchor: وللحالة الآخرة التي هي التجلي بعد الاحتجاب واشتداد الشوق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After pure annihilation, the Lord gives the Prophet true divine existence to guide creation and call to truth; he is satisfied because that gift restores existence.
rows.anchor: الوجود الحقاني لهداية الخلق والدعوة إلى الحق بعد هذا الفناء الصرف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The orphan is the solitary person veiled by self-qualities from the true father, the Holy Spirit; God sheltered him in divine care, educated him, and made his father a guardian to teach and purify him.
rows.anchor: محجوبا بصفات النفس عن نور أبيك الحقيقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being astray means being veiled from essential unity by attributes while in the realm of the spiritual father; God guided the Prophet Himself to the essence.
rows.anchor: عن التوحيد الذاتي عند كونك في عالم أبيك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Neediness is annihilation in God; absolute poverty follows poverty of attributes, and God enriches with gifted true existence and divine perfections. The Prophet should repay this by being grateful and doing for servants as God did for him.
rows.anchor: فقيرا عديما فانيا فيه بالفقر الذي هو سواد الوجه في الدارين الذي هو الفناء المحض بعد الفقر الذي هو فخره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The orphan is lonely, broken-hearted, cut off from sacred light and veiled by the self; do not oppress him, but gently guide him with wisdom and good counsel as God sheltered you.
rows.anchor: المنفرد المنكسر القلب، المنقطع عن نور القدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The asker is a receptive person veiled and astray from his goal; do not scold or bar his question, but guide him as you were guided.
rows.anchor: المستعد المحجوب الضال عن طريق مقصده الطالب إياه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord’s favor is the knowledge and wisdom bestowed in abiding; proclaim it by teaching people and enriching them with true good as God enriched you.
rows.anchor: من العلم والحكمة الفائض عليك في مقام البقاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question rhetorically denies that opening did not occur and thus affirms that God opened the Prophet’s breast.
rows.anchor: استفهام بمعنى إنكار انتفاء الشرح ليفيد ثبوته، أي: شرحنا لك صدرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: During annihilation, the unifier is veiled from creation by the Real and cannot contain anything; before annihilation, limited created existence veils him from receiving the divine self-disclosure. Given true existence, he returns to creation able to contain both Real and creation, which is opening the breast.
rows.anchor: فإذا رد إلى الخلق بالوجود الحقاني الموهوب ورجع إلى التفصيل وسع صدره الحق والخلق لكونه وجودا حقيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prophetic burden is carrying revelation and duties: in witnessing, the Prophet saw only God and could not distinguish acts or command and forbid; returning from sainthood to prophethood, the heart’s veil nearly broke his back. Empowerment in abiding lets him see unity in multiplicity without losing witness during the call, removing the burden and raising his mention.
rows.anchor: ثقل ذلك عليه وكاد أن يقصم ظهره لاحتجابه عن الشهود الذاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Opening also raises the Prophet’s mention: the annihilated one in pure unity would otherwise have no existence or name, and Islam would be incomplete without both declarations, that there is no god but God and Muhammad is God’s messenger.
rows.anchor: وذلك هو شرح الصدر وهو بعينه وضع الوزر المذكور ورفع الذكر لأن الفاني في الجمع لا يكون شيئا فضلا عن أن يكون مذكورا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is the first rank of the Prophet’s return from unity to differentiation and is said to be the first revealed surah. The bāʾ marks instrumental aid: after returning from God to creation, he has gifted divine existence and qualities and is therefore a name, essence with attribute; he reads through the essential existence that is the greatest name.
rows.anchor: نزلت في أول رتبة رده عليه السلام عن الجمع إلى التفصيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lord who created means that He manifested Himself under the form of creation: the Prophet appears in his own form, stands through God in created form, and returns from divine unity to creaturely differentiation.
rows.anchor: احتجب بصورة الخلق، يعني ظهرت بصورتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human is singled out after general creation because the Prophet was returned to the composite human form and veiling required for revelation, descent, and prophethood.
rows.anchor: ولما رده إلى الخلقية في صورة الجمعية الإنسانية وأمره بالاحتجاب بها لتمكن الوحي والتنزيل والنبوة خص الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is unsurpassably generous, having gifted the Prophet His essence and attributes; He would not leave him annihilated without restoring existence, since otherwise no generosity or attribute would appear.
rows.anchor: البالغ إلى النهاية في الكرم الذي لا يمكن فوق غايته كرم لجوده بذاته وصفاته وهب لك ذاته وصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pen is the supreme first spirit, the means through which God taught.
rows.anchor: القلم الأعلى الذي هو الروح الأول الأعظم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God taught the Prophet what he had not known and granted knowledge so that, before he was firmly established in abiding, he would not claim independent perfection and transgress through selfhood; self-sufficiency produces transgression.
rows.anchor: لم يكن له علم فعلمه بعلمه ووهب له صفة عالميته لئلا يرى ذاته موصوفة بصفة الكمال فيطغى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Return to the Lord is annihilation of the self’s essence and attributes; the Prophet responds in proper humility that he is not the reader, God is the true reader.
rows.anchor: بالفناء الذاتي فلا ذات لك ولا صفة فارتدع عليه السلام متأدبا بأدب حاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who forbids is a veiled, ignorant person self-satisfied with his condition, wealth, and clan; the servant is one who prays in attentive presence and worshipful steadiness, whom the forbidding man opposes.
rows.anchor: المحجوب الجاهل المستغني بحاله وماله وقومه عن الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypothetical question about whether the worshipper is guided or commands piety voices the arrogant denier’s own misguided claim and invitation to associationism.
rows.anchor: في شركه ودعوته إلى الشرك فرضا وتقديرا كما زعم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the arrogant man denied truth and turned from the straight religion in stubbornness, he should know God sees either state and will requite him.
rows.anchor: بالحق لكفره وأعرض عن الدين المستقيم لعناده وطغيانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rebuke restrains forbidding prayer and confirms the warning against the denier; failure to stop and his reliance on his group expose his blindness to God’s power through heavenly and earthly forces.
rows.anchor: ردع عن النهي عن الصلاة وإثبات للقسم الثاني من الشرطية بنفي القسم الأول بالوعيد عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not obey the opponent; remain in monotheism. Prostration is annihilation in attentive prayer, drawing near through annihilation of acts, attributes, and essence until abiding in God without residual selfhood.
rows.anchor: لا توافقه ودم على ما أنت عليه من مخالفته بملازمة التوحيد

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: In this prostration the Prophet seeks refuge through God’s act from His act, attribute from attribute, and essence from essence, embodying the three stages of approach.
rows.anchor:
ولهذا قرأ عليه السلام في هذه السجدة:
" أعوذ بعفوك من عقابك "

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: A hadith says the servant is nearest to his Lord while prostrating.
rows.anchor:
وفي الحديث:
" أقرب ما يكون العبد إلى ربه إذا سجد "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Night of Power is the Muhammadan form in the heart station, where the Prophet is veiled after essential witnessing; revelation can descend only in this form and state, and his rank and honor are disclosed there.
rows.anchor: ليلة القدر هي البنية المحمدية حال احتجابه عليه السلام في مقام القلب بعد الشهود الذاتي لان الإنزال لا يمكن إلا في هذه البنية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question magnifies the night’s status: its true rank and honor are beyond what the audience can fathom.
rows.anchor: أي شيء عرفت كنه قدرها وشرفها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A day can signify an event, as in the reminder of God’s days; by analogy each kind is a month containing its individual days, and each genus a year containing kinds as months.
rows.anchor: قد مر أن اليوم يعبر به عن الحادث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A thousand is the complete number beyond which multiplicity comes only by repetition or addition; it means the Prophet alone is better than all kinds.
rows.anchor: والألف هو العدد التام الذي لا كثرة فوقه إلا بالتكرار والإضافة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The descending angels and Spirit signify spiritual and psychic powers and heavenly and earthly kingdoms; they bring every affair, meaning knowledge of all things, beings, attributes, properties, states, management, and subjection.
rows.anchor: من جهة كل أمر هو معرفة جميع الأشياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night is peace from every defect until the dawn of the sun rising in the west and near death, when safety ends; alternatively, it is itself peace, receiving abundant greetings from God, angels, and all people.
rows.anchor: سلام عن جميع النقائص والعيوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelievers are veiled either from the religion and path to the Real, as the People of the Book, or from the Real itself, as polytheists; they stay astray until a clear proof comes.
rows.anchor: حجبوا إما عن الدين وطريق الوصول إلى الحق كأهل الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jews, Christians, and polytheists once quarrelled while claiming their own religion true, yet agreed to wait for the promised Prophet in their books and follow him; the author compares this to sects awaiting the Mahdi and fears they will react similarly.
rows.anchor: كانوا يتخاصمون ويتعاندون ويدعي كل حزب حقية ما عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their divisions and hostility intensified after the proof arrived: every group imagined the Prophet would validate its own inclination, then became more defiant and spiteful when he did not.
rows.anchor: ما تفرقوا تفرقا قويا وما اشتد اختلافهم وتعاندهم إلا من بعدما جاءتهم البينة بخروجه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Messenger is apposition to the proof; the purified pages are tablets of celestial intellects and souls, reached through detachment and free of natural, material, and human corruption, containing enduring, just foundations of the true religion.
rows.anchor: بدل من البينة أي: الحجة القائمة الواضحة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The People of the Book were commanded to devote worship sincerely to God alone and turn from every other path or object; the true religion has three principles: pure monotheism, turning from others in obedience, and bodily and financial practices that purify, especially prayer and zakah.
rows.anchor: عن شوب الباطل والالتفات إلى الغير

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet calls prayer the pillar of religion; al-Qashani presents prayer as the central bodily practice and zakah as the foundation of ascetic detachment.
rows.anchor:
كقوله عليه السلام:
" الصلاة عماد الدين "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The true, upright community has always been one from Adam onward; if earlier communities had not been veiled by passions, scriptural alteration, pride, desires, habits, and wishes, they would have followed the same religion.
rows.anchor: فالملة الحقيقية الحنيفية واحدة من لدن آدم إلى يومنا هذا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Veiled people of any sect are the worst creation, confined in the fire of effects at nature’s bottom.
rows.anchor: فالحاصل أن المحجوبين من أي الفرق كانوا هم شر البرية في نار جهنم الآثار قعر بئر الطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who unify in knowledge and acquire virtues according to justice are the best creation, dwelling in eternal gardens of action and attributes; the highest is the station of contentment.
rows.anchor: الموحدين بالتوحيد العلمي العاملين على قانون العدالة في اكتساب الفضائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear of the Lord is the awe produced when divine majesty manifests in the heart, not fear opposed to contentment; the veiled receive only a portion of fire, while unifiers receive a portion of paradise short of the highest garden, whose peak is contentment and peace.
rows.anchor: ذلك المقام مخصوص بمن علته الخشية الربانية عند تجليه بصفة العظمة لأنه إذا تجلى الرب على القلب بصفة العظمة استولت الخشية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The quaking earth is the body when the human spirit leaves: the animal spirit and powers make it shake as its structure collapses toward ruin.
rows.anchor: أرض البدن عند نزع الروح الإنساني باضطراب الروح الحيواني والقوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth’s burdens are valuable household goods: powers, spirits, and forms of deeds and beliefs firmly settled in the heart.
rows.anchor: متاعها التي هي بها ذات قدر من القوى والأرواح وهيئات الأعمال والاعتقادات الراسخة في القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person asks what caused the bodily shaking and disease, wondering whether temperament deviated or humors overwhelmed it.
rows.anchor: ما لها زلزلت واضطربت ما طبها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth tells its account through its state: the Lord directed and ordered its shaking, collapse, and expulsion of burdens as the spirit departs and death occurs.
rows.anchor: أشار إليها وأمرها بالاضطراب والخراب وإخراج الأثقال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People leave their resting places and bodies for their covenants and places of judgment and recompense, dispersed into the blessed and wretched, to see their deeds’ reward in forms impressed on their souls.
rows.anchor: عن مراقدهم ومخارج أبدانهم إلى مواثيقهم ومواطن حسابهم وجزائهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessed see each atom of good and the wretched each atom of evil; here the general ‘whoever’ is restricted by the preceding division into groups, since disbelief nullifies the wretched’s good while faith, repentance, prevailing good, and sound nature pardon the blessed’s sins.
rows.anchor: قوله أشتاتا لأن خيرات الأشقياء محبطة بالكفر والاحتجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By dawn’s light the knowers center in the essence, becoming subtle through the body’s dust; attainment comes through bodies, as the Prophet’s ascent was bodily. These are spiritually knowing, active, renunciant people who discipline and exhaust the body through self-disclosure’s light and thereby arrive.
rows.anchor: أي: بذلك الصبح ونوره جمع عين الذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The striking catastrophe is the great or lesser resurrection; if great, it is an unknowable state that annihilates what it strikes through disclosure of the one essence and wholly ends human existence.
rows.anchor: الداهية التي تقرع الناس وتهلكهم وهي إما القيامة الكبرى أو الصغرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At witnessing, people resemble scattered moths in humiliation and scattered attention, insignificant to the unifier; the author compares this with the saying that faith is incomplete until people seem like camels or moths.
rows.anchor: يكونون في ذلك الشهود في الذلة وتفرق الوجهة كالفراش المنتثر وأحقر وأذل لأنه لا قدر ولا وقع لهم في عين الموحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mountains signify kinds and levels of existence, becoming scattered dust and disappearing through theophany.
rows.anchor: أي: الأكوان ومراتب الوجود على اختلاف أصنافها وأنواعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the people are the inhabitants of the great resurrection, moths burned and dispersed by theophany; mountains are their selves and qualities, likewise dissolved.
rows.anchor: وإن كان المراد بالناس المقروعين من أهل الكبرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This annihilation reading does not fit the later distinction of heavy and light scales; in God’s scale, rising and ascending count as weight, while descent is lightness: enduring righteous deeds matter most, and perishable pleasures have no weight.
rows.anchor: لا يساعده لانتفاء التفصيل هناك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If people tasted true pleasures of certain knowledge and luminous perception above transient sensation and imagination, they would regret wasting their precious lives in distractions.
rows.anchor: لو ذقتم اللذات الحقيقية من العلوم اليقينية والإدراكات النورية المستعلية على هذه الحسيات والخياليات الفانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will surely see the hell of nature’s effects because they are veiled by sensory things.
rows.anchor: والله لترون بسبب احتجابكم بهذه المحسوسات نار جحيم الطبيعة الآثارية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will then taste it through direct realization beyond knowledge and be asked about the blessing: was it perishable worldly pleasure or the everlasting afterlife good they denied? The author also allows the vision clause to stand as the answer to both oath and conditional, citing a Qur’anic example.
rows.anchor: لتذوقنها عيانا يقينيا بالذوق والوجدان فوق العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One extended reading says certainty would expose nature’s hell and the painful consequences of sensual, imaginary, and bodily pleasures; knowledge’s beauty and permanence would lead to direct witnessing of sacred lights and divine attributes and seeing that hell clearly.
rows.anchor: لو علمتم علم اليقين ووصلتم إلى مرتبته لرأيتم نار جحيم الطبيعة المخصوصة بالمحجوبين بهذه الرذائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, certainty reveals hell from intense longing and love’s fire; longing advances to direct vision of that fire, then questioning concerns the gift of arrival, tasting the reality of certainty and reporting it.
rows.anchor: أو لو تعلمون العلم اليقيني أيها المحجوبون بهذه الزخارف والخرافات لترون الجحيم من شدة الشوق واستيلاء نار العشق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rebuke rejects the impossible assumption: the person will be cast from his natural fitra into dominating nature, the crushing realm that breaks whatever enters it, a spiritual fire hostile to the heart and penetrating its noblest, spirit-connected core.
rows.anchor: ردع عن حسبان وقوع الممتنع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire is shut over them because the heart is trapped by bodily matter, entrenched dark dispositions and animal, predatory, and satanic forms, with no escape to holiness; extended columns are elemental natures binding it through attachment and love.
rows.anchor: مطبقة مغلقة الأبواب لاحتجاب القلب في محلها بالمواد الجسمانية واستحكام الهيئات المظلمة واللواحق الهيولانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The famous elephant expedition, near the Prophet’s era, exemplifies divine power and anger at violating His sanctuary.
rows.anchor: قصة أصحاب الفيل مشهورة وواقعتهم كانت قريبة من عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهي إحدى آيات قدرة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Birds and beasts can receive inspiration more readily because their souls are simple, and stones can act by qualities God placed in them; knowledge of the realm of power reveals such events’ causes. The author cites mice overrunning Abiward and crossing the Gyhun on pieces of wood as a contemporary parallel, and says such events resist allegorical dismissal like resurrection.
rows.anchor: وإلهام الطيور والوحوش أقرب من إلهام الإنسان لكون نفوسهم ساذجة وتأثير الأحجار بخاصية أودعها الله تعالى فيها ليس بمستنكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the spiritual application, Abyssinian nafs/Abrha tries to destroy the heart, the true House of God, and divert the spiritual powers’ pilgrimage toward bodily nature; practical intellect disrupts this scheme while spiritual powers kindle longing and discipline the body.
rows.anchor: أبرهة النفس الحبشية لما قصد تخريب كعبة القلب الذي هو بيت الله بالحقيقة والاستيلاء عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The aggressor’s forces are dark psychic powers such as anger and appetite, led by the elephant of satanic imagination that resists intellect and often appears as an elephant.
rows.anchor: وقدم فيل شيطان الوهم الذي لا ينهزم عن جنود العقل ويعارضه في الحرب والشيطان أكثر ما يتشكل يكون بصورة الفيل

rows.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says Satan places his trunk on Adam’s heart and withdraws when God is remembered.
rows.anchor:
قال عليه السلام:
" إن الشيطان ليضع خرطومه على قلب ابن آدم فإذا ذكر الله خنس "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God rendered the plot useless, then sent flocks of birds signifying thoughts and remembrances, illuminated by the spirit; their grouped forms are like syllogisms and repeated remembrances.
rows.anchor: طيور الأفكار والأذكار بيضاء منورة بنور الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Stones from fired clay signify disciplines prescribed by religious law and reason, individually assigned to destroy particular powers: surrender for anger, fasting for appetite, humility for pride, and meekness for tyranny.
rows.anchor: رياضة مما سجل وخص بكل واحد منهم كتب على كل واحد منها اسم المرمي بها بقلم الشرع والعقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The troops become inert like consumed straw: discipline kills the vegetative powers and removes their capacity and characteristic force.
rows.anchor: كقوى نباتية أميتت وذهبت قوتها وخاصيتها ووقفت عن فعلها لضعفها بالرياضة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Quraysh signifies the spiritual powers agreeing and cooperating to gain virtues and unite toward perfection through winter’s journey, when the spirit-sun descends toward the body and attends to livelihood and bodily needs, and summer’s journey, when it nears the zenith and ascends toward holiness and certainty.
rows.anchor: القوى الروحانية وإيقاع مؤالفتها وموافقتها ومسالمتها في اكتساب الفضائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should worship the Lord of this House through monotheism, exclusive worship, and turning toward Him after knowing Him.
rows.anchor: بالتوحيد وتخصيص العبادة به والتوجه نحوه بعد معرفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God feeds them meanings of certainty, true gnosis, and divine realities in response to innate readiness’s hunger amid simple ignorance.
rows.anchor: أطعمة المعاني اليقينية والمعارف الحقيقية والحقائق الإلهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Safety from fear means protection from seizure by the forces of the psyche that prevent obedience, destroy their inner sanctuary, capture their freedom, and devastate them.
rows.anchor: استيلاء حبشة القوى النفسانية وتخطفهم إياهم ومنعهم عن الانقياد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two surahs were one in Ubayy’s codex, and some senior Companions recited both together in the second rakʿah of the evening prayer.
rows.anchor: والسورتان كانتا في مصحف أبي سورة واحدة وبعض كبار الصحابة قرأهما في ثانية المغرب معا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The denier of recompense is ignorant and veiled from the disgraceful consequence; this person embodies all vices because ignorance and veiling in the rational faculty are their root.
rows.anchor: هل عرفت الجاهل المحجوب عن الجزاء من هوان لم تعرفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Driving away an orphan means harming and harshly shoving the weak through the excessive predatory soul.
rows.anchor: يؤذي الضعيف ويدفعه بعنف وخشونة لاستيلاء النفس السبعية وإفراطها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Failing to urge feeding the poor means withholding kindness from those entitled, due to animal-soul dominance, love of wealth, and entrenched miserliness.
rows.anchor: ويمنع المعروف عن المستحق لاستيلاء النفس البهيمية وبمحبة المال واستحكام رذيلة البخل في نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The abundant good is knowing multiplicity through unity, detailed monotheism, and witnessing unity within multiplicity and the many as one; it is also a heavenly river whose drinker never thirsts.
rows.anchor: معرفة الكثرة بالوحدة وعلم التوحيد التفصيلي وشهود الوحدة في عين الكثرة بتجلي الواحد الكثير والكثير الواحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After witnessing the one in multiplicity, pray with full uprightness: spirit witnessing, heart present, self obedient, and body turning through worship, so prayer fulfills unity and differentiation.
rows.anchor: إذا شاهدت الواحد في عين الكثرة فصل بالاستقامة الصلاة التامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sacrifice the apparent selfhood to avoid variegation and loss of steadfastness; abide in God through total annihilation.
rows.anchor: بدنة أنائيتك لئلا تظهر في شهودك بالتلوين وتسلبك مقام التمكين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is not cut off in arrival or state: his community remains connected as true descendants, whereas his opponent alone is cut off and truly perishes.
rows.anchor: مبغضك الذي على خلاف حالك المنقطع عن الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unbelievers have covered their original light of readiness with dark self-qualities and effects of nature, becoming veiled from the Real by other things.
rows.anchor: الذين ستروا نور استعدادهم الأصلي بظلمة صفات النفوس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet will never worship the gods they invented from whim, imagination, and rational representation, because he witnesses the Real through essential vision.
rows.anchor: ما تعبدون } من الآلهة المجعولة بهواكم، المصورة بخيالكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They can never worship what the Prophet worships while remaining in their veiled state, since rusted hearts cannot know the Real.
rows.anchor: لامتناع معرفة الحق من الذين طبع على قلوبهم بالرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet never worshipped their objects even before reaching completion, because his primordial readiness was complete and directed to God while theirs was deficient; nor can they worship his object according to their original nature. The repeated denials negate possibility in the future, present state, essential constitution, and eternity.
rows.anchor: في الزمان الماضي قبل الكمال والوصول التام بحسب الاستعداد الأول والفطرة الأولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since agreement in worship is impossible, the Prophet leaves them to their religion and asks them to leave him to his.
rows.anchor: لما لم يكن الوفاق بيننا تركتكم ودينكم فاتركوني وديني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s help is support from the spiritual kingdom and holiness through disclosures of names and attributes; the opening is the final opening of the oneness-presence after the spirit’s manifest victory.
rows.anchor: المدد الملكوتي والتأييد القدسي بتجليات الأسماء والصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People enter monotheism and the straight path through the Prophet’s light once he has completed his own perfection; those ready ones come in groups as one soul receiving his overflow through a fitting spiritual relation.
rows.anchor: التوحيد والسلوك على الصراط المستقيم بتأثير نورك فيهم عند فراغك من تكميل نفسك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorify and praise by removing the self’s veiling in the heart station, cutting the body’s tie and rising to the sainthood station of certainty; seek God’s concealment of the self in Himself as in prior annihilation, for He receives the returning servant by annihilating him in His light.
rows.anchor: نزه ذاتك من الاحتجاب بمقام القلب الذي هو معدن النبوة بقطع علاقة البدن والترقي إلى مقام حق اليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once religion and the prophetic mission are complete, the Prophet is told to return to the station of certainty, which continues only after death.
rows.anchor: ولما كمل الدين واستقرت دعوته التي كانت بعثته لأجلها أمره بالرجوع إلى مقام حق اليقين الذي لا يستمر إلا بعد الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the surah was revealed, the Companions rejoiced while Ibn ʿAbbas wept, interpreting it as foretelling the Prophet’s death; the Prophet praised his knowledge.
rows.anchor: بكى ابن عباس فقال صلى الله عليه وسلم: " ما يبكيك؟ " قال: نعيت إليك نفسك!

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In another report, the Prophet told the people God had offered a servant a choice between the world and meeting Him; Abu Bakr understood and offered his life, wealth, parents, and children for the Prophet.
rows.anchor: خطب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: " إن عبدا خيره الله بين الدنيا وبين لقائه فاختار لقاء الله "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet told Fatima that his death had been foretold; she cried, then laughed when he said she would be the first of his family to join him.
rows.anchor: وعنه أنه دعا فاطمة عليها السلام فقال: " يا بنتاه! نعيت إلي نفسي "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The surah is called the Farewell Surah; reports say the Prophet lived two years after it was revealed at the Farewell Pilgrimage.
rows.anchor: وتسمى هذه السورة (سورة التوديع)، وروي أنه عاش بعدها سنتين ونزلت في حجة الوداع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Lahab’s hands, the cause of his evil deeds, perish, and his evil self perishes according to its own readiness; he deserves fire by essence and quality, and his kunya signals permanent attachment to it.
rows.anchor: هلك ما هو سبب عمله الخبيث الذي استحق به الجهنمي الملازم لنار الهلاك وهلك ذاته الخبيثة لاستحقاقها بحسب استعدادها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His original wealth signifies innate preparatory knowledge and his earnings false belief; neither benefits him because his beliefs do not match reality, and both contribute to torment.
rows.anchor: ما نفعه ماله الأصلي من العلم الاستعدادي الفطري ولا مكسوبه لعدم مطابقة اعتقاده لما في نفس الأمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He burns in a great, flaming fire because of associationism and the additional malice of his deeds and their forms.
rows.anchor: زائد على أصله لخبث أعماله وهيئاتها فيصلى بالاعتقاد الفاسد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His wife shares the fire with him; carrying wood means carrying sins and evil forms that fuel Hell.
rows.anchor: التي تحمل أوزار آثامها وهيئات أعمالها الخبيثة التي هي وقود نار جهنم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tightly twisted rope is a chain of fire: because she loved vices and indecencies, her deeds’ forms and sins are bound to her neck as punishment corresponding to her actions.
rows.anchor: قوي مما مسد، أي: فتل فتلا قويا من سلاسل النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to say comes from the station of unity to differentiated manifestation; He is pure essential oneness, the essence as it is without any attribute, known only by Himself.
rows.anchor: أمر من عين الجمع وارد على مظهر التفصيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Allah is apposition for the essence with all attributes, indicating that attributes are identical with essence in reality and differ only conceptually; the surah is called Sincerity because it purifies pure oneness from multiplicity.
rows.anchor: والله بدل منه وهو اسم الذات مع جميع الصفات دال بالإبدال على أن صفاته تعالى ليست بزائدة على ذاته بل هي عين الذات

rows.speaker: أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام
rows.claim: ʿAli says that perfect sincerity to God means negating attributes of Him, since each attribute bears witness to its difference from the subject and vice versa; the saying that attributes are neither He nor other is true in different respects.
rows.anchor: كما قال أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام: " كمال الإخلاص له نفي الصفات عنه "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ahad is the essence alone without multiplicity, absolute existence without restriction; Wahid is the essence considered with its attributes, the realm of divine names, since a name is essence with an attribute.
rows.anchor: والواحد هو الذات مع اعتبار كثرة الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He refers to the inaccessible pure reality known only by God; Allah, the essence with all attributes, replaces it to show attributes are truly identical with essence, and the predicate Ahad shows conceptual multiplicity does not affect unity, like imagined drops in the sea.
rows.anchor: وأبدل عنها الذات مع جميع الصفات دلالة على أنها عين الذات وحدها في الحقيقة
